# Hetzner

Use `hetzner/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "hetzner-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "hetzner/Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8",
});
```
